then.message: PROV-GRAMMAR: Rendering operation needs an explicit provenance law.
PROV-SLOT: Only declared composition slots may be external provenance inputs.
PROV-SLOT: A composed slot requires an explicit source map.
PROV-JOIN: Child provenance must reproduce the exact rendered dependency.

steps.message: PROV-REPRODUCTION: Provenance does not reproduce the projection. Refuse the build.

provenance.locate.message: PROV-OFFSET: Use an in-range nonnegative integer coordinate.
PROV-OFFSET: Offset is outside this generated node.
PROV-COVERAGE: This generated character has no derivation.

value.boundary: Exact generated definition; no inverse edit is claimed.

provenance.resolve.message: PROV-MAP: Select an artifact with a character map.
PROV-OFFSET: Offset is outside the artifact.

provenance.accept.message: PROV-PRODUCER: More than one producer claims an artifact.

steps.message: PROV-UNDECLARED: Output has no declared producer. Refuse automatic admission.
PROV-MISSING: A declared producer did not emit its artifact.
PROV-SOURCE: Producer refers to an undeclared source owner.

then.message: PROV-COPY: A byte copy requires exactly one owner.
PROV-COPY: Copied bytes do not agree with their canonical owner.

provenance.pointer.message: PROV-SOURCE: Missing declared source value for provenance.
PROV-POINTER: Attribution points to a missing source field or algebra rule.

value.boundary: Character maps identify source nodes and rules. Declared-input records for native and composed snapshots do not assert character-level derivation.
